description: This file defines the ViewWizard class for the SuiteCRM project, responsible for rendering a user preferences/setup wizard interface. It includes methods for initializing the view, rendering the interface, and processing various user and system settings such as locale, currencies, timezones, email configurations, and more.

classes.name: ViewWizard
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages the display and initialization of the user setup wizard interface in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing options for the wizard view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the wizard interface, assigns user and system preferences, loads necessary resources, and displays the template.

methods.name: correctCurrenciesSymbolsSort
methods.description: Sorts currencies alphabetically with US Dollar as the first element.

methods.name: pushCurrencyArrayToString
methods.description: Converts an array of currency symbols into JavaScript code assigning them to a currencies object.
